title: Wonderful humidifier, works great and I sleep much better now!
text: Wonderful humidifier, works great and I sleep much better now!. I have been using this Vick's humidifier almost nightly since I received it. Normally my bedroom, especially this time of the year is dry and cold and I wake up with a semi sore throat. Given that I also suffer from allergies. I rarely get a good night's sleep because my nasal passages also fill up overnight. Since I have been using this,  I awake refreshed and my throat is clear and not raw. I have not used this with Vicks Vaporub in the device yet, but I can definitely see where this will be my definitive go to when I catch my next cold. My room is 16X20 and I keep the device on my nightstand for optimal impact. Highly recommend.

product_metadata.title: Vicks Filtered Cool Mist Humidifier, Medium Room, 1.1 Gallon Tank - Humidifier for Baby and Kids Rooms, Bedrooms and More, Works with Vicks VapoPads
features: FILTERED COOL MIST HUMIDIFER – Vicks Filtered Cool Mist Humidifier is an essential part of a good night’s sleep when family members are sick, during allergy season or the air is dry. Works with Vicks VapoPads (sample included) for extra soothing comfort

CLEANER MOISTURE – Cool mist humidifier includes a filter that filters minerals from the water, so the moisture is cleaner It also accepts 2 Vicks VapoPads (sample included) for soothing comfort With a 1 1 gallon tank, it can operate for up to 24 hours

COUGH AND CONGESTION RELIEF – Humidifiers for home can be helpful during cold and flu season, when it’s difficult to sleep with cough and congestion. A humidifier or vaporizer can provide temporary relief by adding necessary moisture to the air

HUMIDIFIERS FOR BEDROOM AND MORE – A filtered cool mist humidifier is great for a baby, young children and adults, and fits perfectly into any room Use when the air is dry, in allergy season, when sick or even to maintain optimal indoor humidity levels

A CENTURY OF POWERFUL RELIEF – At Vicks, we believe that everyone deserves a touch of care. Our line of humidifiers, steam inhalers and vaporizers help you breathe better and sleep more comfortably, wherever you are
description: Return essential moisture to dry air in your home with the Vicks filtered cool Moisture humidifier. Ideal for medium-size rooms, This quiet personal humidifier delivers invisible, soothing Mist for everyday comfort. Featuring two output settings, this air humidifier has a self-regulating Evaporative system that automatically adjusts the output for maximum effectiveness, and it can operate for up to 24 hours on the low setting. The mist Humidifier features a 1.1-Gallon tank that is easy to fill and clean, and it includes a wicking filter that removes minerals and impurities from water for cleaner moisture. The Vicks filtered cool Moisture humidifier accepts two Vicks VapoPads so that you can add soothing vapors to your mist. Do not block intake or output vents.
